Callout.Name: Casino - Suspected Cheating
Callout.Message: Casino staff reporting a suspected cheat at a table.
Callout.Advisory: One suspect detained by security, no weapons.

Script.Line: I have been at this table two hours and winning is not a crime.
The cards are the casino cards. Count them.
Security put hands on me before I said a word.

Lines.Approach: Security have them at the table and want it on the record, not on the floor.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
